rationale: Asoma brings deep expertise in computational materials science and molecular dynamics simulation—research areas that could power the hardware and on-device inference systems Era is building at Edge. Era's focus on edge intelligence and privacy-preserving hardware aligns naturally with Asoma's work on polymer materials and solid electrolytes, and connecting them could surface new applications at the intersection of applied materials science and edge AI infrastructure.
intro_message: Asoma Yuichiro, meet Era Qian — your work on computational chemistry and materials informatics could inform the hardware foundations Era is developing for on-device AI at Edge.
